history.body: Hi, my partner and I saw your Pearl Residences ad. We’re looking for a home with space for a home office. Could you tell me more?

Pearl Residences’ Type A is 900 sq. ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. One bedroom could potentially be set up as a home office, depending on the layout and how you’d furnish it—giving you a separate place to work. Are you looking for a dedicated office, or a bedroom that can double as one?
A bedroom that can double as an office would probably be enough, as long as it’s practical for two people working from home. Do you have a floor plan, and what’s the price range?

Type A is 900 sq. ft. with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. I don’t have the approved floor plan or current price range to share yet, so I’ll confirm both. The room dimensions will help assess whether a bedroom can comfortably work for two people.
